title: Text model routing gets narrower
summary:
Text-model routing was pared back, two community projects joined the directory, and Mirexa’s listing got a clearer label.

The Portkey mapping no longer selects upstream models for eleven text-model aliases, including `claude`, `gemini`, and `command-r`. No replacement routing was added in the change.

The project list added @ray23-bit’s Indonesian-language Rizqi O Chatbot, which combines chat, images, and text-to-audio, and @henk717’s KoboldAI, a browser-based writing interface that uses Pollinations for image generation.

Mirexa’s model description now identifies it as an AI companion using GPT-4.1 and lists Azure as its provider. Model behavior did not change.
